coverage_boundary.interpretation: A facility is in coverage when it is within 25 km of the Machilipatnam–Vijayawada corridor path, or its locality is on the documented corridor list. District-only matches are queued for manual review rather than displayed.
coverage_boundary.unresolved: Facilities with neither coordinates nor a recognisable corridor locality cannot be placed; they are listed under "requires review" with their source.

known_limitations: Government directory pages publish name, address, category and pincode only — no phone, coordinates, opening hours or staff lists. Those fields stay absent rather than invented.
Private hospitals not listed in a government directory are only included when a reviewed source (provider site or insurance network) was available.
dme.ap.nic.in (Directorate of Medical Education) did not respond within the request timeout and is not used as an automatic source.
This is the coverage ACHIEVED from the listed sources, not a claim that every facility in the corridor has been found.
